desc:
A 2D PUZZLE PLATFORMER! Blink into a world of after-images, where you can walk on light. Solve puzzles by manipulating lights and blinking between worlds. Explore hand drawn landscapes while uncovering the secrets behind this strange power. 👁️

- New level select feature in the pause menu! (Look for the gear icon next to the Roblox menu)
- Multiplayer support, your friends can show up as ghosts in your world to help guide you if you get stuck!

This was the first game that Jelloman and I made, and it has some rough spots, but hopefully you enjoy the game that started us down the path to Journey to the Sun, Abyssal and more! 😊 

- Luxumbra & Jelloman
